info.title: Symplast Patients Public API
info.description: Authenticated, minimal read-only public surface for patient records and their contact, emergency-contact, employment and referral information.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `patients.basic.read`

Returns a cursor-paged feed of the caller's tenant's patients that the signed-in user may access. Deleted and
inactive patients are included with flags.

Ordered by `updatedAt` ascending, then `id` ascending. Resume with `updatedSince` or follow `next`.

`updatedAt` reflects changes to the patient record only: edits to contact information, emergency contact,
employment or referral do not move a patient in this feed. Delivery is at-least-once across passes; dedupe
on `id` keeping the highest `updatedAt`, and resume at `updatedSince = lastSeen - overlap`.

A malformed or out-of-range `pageSize` or `updatedSince` returns `400` with code `invalid-query-parameter`,
naming every rejected parameter; a missing `pageSize` uses the default.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, taken from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Pass it back unchanged; omit it for the first page. The `next` link already carries it.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only patients whose record changed at or after this instant (inclusive), as an ISO-8601 date-time; a value with no offset is UTC. Changes to contact information, emergency contact, employment or referral do not count. To resume a sync, pass the largest `updatedAt` you have already received (less a small overlap), or follow `next`. Omit it to start from the beginning of the feed.

403.description:
The request has no signed-in user the API can resolve, or the user does not exist in the caller's tenant. That is an RFC 9457 problem with code `user-context-required`.

A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `patients.referral.read`

Returns the patient's referral source, referring and primary-care physicians, provider, coordinator and
first-contact date.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The patient id, unique within the caller's tenant.

403.description:
The request has no signed-in user the API can resolve, or the user does not exist in the caller's tenant. That is an RFC 9457 problem with code `user-context-required`.

ContactMethod.description: A way of contacting a patient. `home`: home phone. `work`: work phone. `cell`: cell phone. `fax`: fax. `pager`: pager. `email`: email. `other`: another method the practice records.

data.description: The items in this page, in feed order. Empty when there are none.

pageSize.description: The page size used for this page: the requested `pageSize`, or the default.

count.description: The number of items in `data`; never more than `pageSize`.

hasMore.description: Whether another page follows. Keep paging while this is true.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, to pass as `cursor`. Null when `hasMore` is false.

next.description: Relative URL of the next page, ready to request. Null when `hasMore` is false.

PagedResponsePublicPatient.description: One page of `PublicPatient` items. Keep following `next` (or pass `nextCursor` as `cursor`) while `hasMore` is true.

PatientMode.description: Whether a patient record is an active patient or a prospect. `active`: an active patient. `prospect`: a prospect (lead) who is not yet an active patient.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: URI reference identifying this occurrence of the problem.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details describing an error response.

PublicAddress.description: A postal address. Used for both the patient's home address and their employer's address.

id.description: The patient id, unique within the tenant.

updatedAt.description: The last change to the patient record, as a UTC instant. The feed watermark.

createdAt.description: When the patient record was created (UTC), or null if not recorded.

firstName.description: The first name, or null if not set.

middleName.description: The middle name, or null if not set.

lastName.description: The last name, or null if not set.

preferredName.description: The preferred name (nickname), or null if not set.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth (calendar date), or null if not set or not a valid date.

sex.description: The recorded sex, a free-form value from the practice's records, or null if not set.

status.description: Whether the patient is active or inactive.

oneOf.description: Whether the record is an active patient or a prospect (lead), or null if not recorded.

isDeleted.description: Whether the patient has been deleted in the practice's system.

physicianId.description: The user id of the patient's assigned physician, or null if none.

providerId.description: The patient's provider id, or null if none.

locationId.description: The patient's practice location id, or null if none.

PublicPatient.description:
The minimal public projection of a patient record. This is the entire externally exposed field set: it excludes SSN,
legal name, marital status, spouse, gender identity, race, ethnicity, language, notes, sticky notes, images, portal
user/login data, integration ids, referral source, conversion and intake status.

oneOf.description: The primary address, or null if none is recorded.

cellPhone.description: The cell phone number, or null.

homePhone.description: The home phone number, or null.

workPhone.description: The work phone number, or null.

oneOf.description: The patient's preferred contact method, or null if not set.

doNotCallCellPhone.description: Whether the patient asked not to be called on their cell phone.

doNotCallHomePhone.description: Whether the patient asked not to be called at home.

doNotCallWorkPhone.description: Whether the patient asked not to be called at work.

doNotEmail.description: Whether the patient asked not to be emailed.

updatedAt.description: Approximate UTC time of the last contact or address change, or null.

PublicPatientContactInformation.description: A patient's contact information and primary address.

firstName.description: The contact's first name, or null.

lastName.description: The contact's last name, or null.

relationship.description: The contact's relationship to the patient, or null.

homePhone.description: The contact's home phone number, or null.

workPhone.description: The contact's work phone number, or null.

employmentTypeId.description: The practice's employment type id, or null.

employerName.description: The employer or school name, or null.

PublicPatientEmployment.description: A patient's employment. The employer contact person's name is not exposed.

referralSourceValue.description: The referral source detail value, or null.

firstContactDate.description: The date of first contact, or null.

updatedAt.description: Approximate UTC time of the last referral change, or null.

PublicPatientReferral.description: How a patient was referred. Free-text notes are not exposed.

id.description: The person's id in the practice's records.

name.description: The person's display name, or null.

PublicPersonReference.description: A reference to a person known to the practice.

Bearer.description: Bearer access token. Send it as the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

tags.name: Patients
tags.description: The practice's patients. Sync patient records from the change feed, then fetch contact information, emergency contact, employment and referral details for one patient as needed.
